title: WHEN THE ROAD AHEAD
FEELS UNCERTAIN
end: The Secret Place — prayers every day

scenes.a: Your dark room holds too many questions tonight.
You lie awake wondering how to navigate the road ahead.
And the LORD went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way;
and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light; to go by day and night:
scenes.sub: TO GIVE THEM LIGHT BY NIGHT

scenes.a: Lord, you who guided your people through the wilderness, go before me into this quiet night.
Let your steady light calm my restless thoughts and cover this room in quiet safety.
I release my heavy tomorrow into your faithful hands. Amen, whenever your dark room holds too many questions.
